text: Checkout 5xx spike after release. Symptoms: 5xx responses rising minutes after a release; NullPointerException in promo validation. title: Order errors after release were a downstream outage

remediation_outcome: recovered after failover; the rollback was unnecessary

title: Search CPU saturation during a sale
symptoms: cpu 96 percent, request rate tripled, latency rising
evidence: thread pool saturated in the logs
resolution: scaled from 3 to 6 replicas
text: Search CPU saturation during a sale. Symptoms: cpu 96 percent, request rate tripled, latency rising. Evidence: request rate 3 times baseline; thread pool saturated in the logs. Root cause: legitimate traffic spike above capacity. Resolution: scaled from 3 to 6 replicas. Outcome: cpu 55 percent within 6 minutes.

title: Gateway CPU high from a retry storm

evidence: client retries increased request volume 4 times after an upstream failure
confirmed_root_cause: retry storm caused by upstream timeouts, not organic traffic
resolution: scaled the gateway to 6 replicas; the owner fixed the upstream later
remediation_outcome: cpu recovered but the upstream fix was required
text: Gateway CPU high from a retry storm. Symptoms: cpu 98 percent with identical alerts every minute. Evidence: client retries increased request volume 4 times after an upstream failure. Root cause: retry storm caused by upstream timeouts, not organic traffic. Resolution: scaled the gateway to 6 replicas; the owner fixed the upstream later. title: Payment memory leak over four hours
symptoms: heap climbing 2 percent per minute with long garbage collection pauses
evidence: linear memory growth and no deployment in 24 hours
resolution: rolling restart, cache cap fix scheduled
remediation_outcome: memory 48 percent after restart; recurred after 9 days without the fix
text: Payment memory leak over four hours. Symptoms: heap climbing 2 percent per minute with long garbage collection pauses. Evidence: linear memory growth and no deployment in 24 hours; GC overhead warnings. Root cause: unbounded ledger cache. Resolution: rolling restart, cache cap fix scheduled. Outcome: memory 48 percent after restart; recurred after 9 days without the fix.

title: Report memory spike from a large export
symptoms: memory 93 percent during an export job
evidence: memory fell when the job ended
confirmed_root_cause: single large export job that released memory afterwards
resolution: no action; export batching tuned
text: Report memory spike from a large export. Symptoms: memory 93 percent during an export job. Evidence: spike matched the nightly export; memory fell when the job ended. Root cause: single large export job that released memory afterwards. Resolution: no action; export batching tuned. Outcome: self-recovered in 11 minutes.

title: Catalog latency from a slow query
symptoms: p95 latency 3.8 seconds; database queries taking 3 seconds
evidence: slow query log shows a full table scan

resolution: index recreated by the database team; no sandbox action
text: Catalog latency from a slow query. Symptoms: p95 latency 3.8 seconds; database queries taking 3 seconds. Evidence: slow query log shows a full table scan; an index was dropped during a migration. Root cause: missing index after a migration. Resolution: index recreated by the database team; no sandbox action. Outcome: p95 back to 250 ms.

title: Auth latency caused by cache eviction

evidence: cache hit ratio fell from 96 percent to 40 percent

resolution: owner increased the cache memory limit
text: Auth latency caused by cache eviction. Symptoms: p95 latency 2 seconds; cache hit ratio dropped. Evidence: cache hit ratio fell from 96 percent to 40 percent; cache memory at its limit. Root cause: cache evictions from a too small memory limit. Resolution: owner increased the cache memory limit. Outcome: latency recovered in 5 minutes.

title: Inventory crash loop with OOMKilled

evidence: OOMKilled exit code 137 in the logs

Root cause: memory limit too low after cache growth. Resolution: restarted the service; owner raised the memory limit. Outcome: healthy within 5 minutes.

title: Shipping latency from the carrier API

title: Auth latency after a cache TTL change
symptoms: p95 latency 1.8 seconds ten minutes after a configuration change
resolution: reverted cache.ttl_seconds to 300
text: Auth latency after a cache TTL change. Symptoms: p95 latency 1.8 seconds ten minutes after a configuration change. Evidence: config change cache.ttl_seconds 300 to 10; cache miss ratio 90 percent. Root cause: cache TTL set too low. Resolution: reverted cache.ttl_seconds to 300. Outcome: latency recovered in 3 minutes.
